title: Full regression suite — confirm zero regressions from Phase 1 + Phase 2 changes
description: Run the full test suite (frontend Vitest 860 tests + sidecar Vitest stress + integration tests) end-to-end. Verify the 860+ baseline from Phase 1 still holds and the new stress + integration tests are green. Record final counts in regression-report.json.
action: Run three test commands in order: (1) `cd desktop && npm test` (frontend Vitest, baseline 860/860 from Phase 1); (2) `cd desktop/src-tauri/bin/sidecar && npx vitest run` (sidecar default config — picks up new stress + integration tests); (3) Optional: `npx vitest run --config vitest.phase2.config.js` if Phase 2 config covers different scope. Capture output of each in `.workflow/scratch/20260503-plan-P2-l4-l5-workflow-hardening/regression-report.json` with shape `{frontend: {total, passed, failed, files}, sidecar_default: {...}, sidecar_phase2: {...}, baseline_match: bool, regressions: []}`. baseline_match is true iff frontend total >= 860 AND frontend.failed === 0.

criteria: regression-report.json.regressions is empty array OR each entry justified
regression-report.json.sidecar_default.failed === 0 OR all failures are documented as deferred in TASK-006
convergence.verification: cd desktop && npm test -- --run && cd src-tauri/bin/sidecar && npx vitest run
convergence.definition_of_done: Frontend baseline preserved (860+ pass, 0 fail), sidecar tests green or deferrals explicit. Phase 2 ready to close.

files.change: JSON report aggregating all test runs with baseline comparison

implementation: Run `cd desktop && npm test -- --run` (vitest run mode, no watch). Parse output for total/passed/failed counts and test file count.
Run `cd desktop/src-tauri/bin/sidecar && npx vitest run`. Parse same.
If a phase2/3/4 config exists and is materially different (different test scope), run that too. Skip if config is just a duplicate.

Build regression-report.json: copy counts from each run, set baseline_match = (frontend.total >= 860 AND frontend.failed === 0), set regressions = list of any test that was passing in PLN-005 TST-004 but is now failing (cross-reference Phase 1 test-results.json).
If regressions detected: STOP — flag back to TASK-005 for additional fixes. Do NOT mark task complete with regressions present.
If sidecar tests have remaining failures from TASK-006 deferrals, list them in regression-report.json.deferred[] not regressions[].
Update state.json or downstream verify hook is responsibility of PLN/EXC artifacts, not this task.

success_metrics: Sidecar tests green or deferrals explicit
No new regressions vs Phase 1 baseline

rationale.chosen_approach: Final regression gate ensures Phase 2 changes (especially fixes in level4-brainstorm.js, level5-coordinator.js, session-manager.js, and DI wiring at sidecar bootstrap) didn't break Phase 1's verified surface.
decision_factors: Catches integration regressions DI might cause
rationale.tradeoffs: Quick task — value comes from running it last, after all changes are in.

risks: DI wiring change in TASK-007 could cause sidecar startup failure for other tests — regression-report must surface this
